meta.title: A lot split that failed must not be reported as done
gaps: No operation or named METHOD/path is provided for splitting an event into lots or causing one lot round to fail validation.
The available read-back fields do not include event lots or lot status, so the absence of created lots and return to draft cannot be asserted.
The setup vocabulary cannot create a vendor whose old line totals are all 0 or configure the specified failed-save condition.
